map.由月债务与月收入求债务收入比 使用指南: Debt-to-Income Ratio from Monthly Debt and Monthly Income User Guide
map.债务收入比(DTI)计算器，输入月债务支出与月收入求 DTI，用于房贷等授信偿债: The debt-to-income (DTI) calculator takes monthly debt payments and monthly income to compute DTI, for repayment risk assessment in mortgages and other lending.
map.DTI=月债务支出÷月收入，常见警戒线 43%~50%，越低偿债压力越小。仅含房: DTI = monthly debt payments ÷ monthly income; the common warning line is 43%~50%, and the lower it is the lighter the repayment burden. It covers only debt-like outflows such as mortgage, car loan and credit card minimums, not everyday spending.
map.申请房贷前自测偿债能力是否达标。: Self-test repayment capacity before applying for a mortgage.
map.银行授信时评估月供占收入的安全边界。: Assess the safe boundary of monthly payment over income when evaluating bank credit.
map.规划新增贷款前控制整体负债水平。: Control the overall debt level before planning new loans.
map.月债务 8,000、月收入 20,000 的 DTI: DTI with monthly debt 8,000 and monthly income 20,000
map.：DTI=月债务支出÷月收入=8,000÷20,000=40%。多数银行要求房贷: : DTI = monthly debt payments ÷ monthly income = 8,000÷20,000=40%. Most banks cap mortgage DTI at 50% (including this payment), so 40% is acceptable but leaves little room.
map.常见警戒线为 43%~50%。DTI 越高，发生逾期的风险越大；低于 36% 通: The common warning line is 43%~50%. The higher the DTI, the greater the delinquency risk; below 36% the repayment burden is usually considered light.
map.标准 DTI 只算「债务性支出」（房贷、车贷、信用卡最低还款等），不计入吃饭、交: Standard DTI counts only "debt-like outflows" (mortgage, car loan, credit card minimums), not food and transport. Some institutions also quote a "DTI including living expenses".
